skill.displayName: 视频号-直播回放列表 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed paid Qinghu qhkit integration for checking WeChat Channels live replay history, with some install and token setup users should approve first.

dimensions.detail: Network access, a Qinghu token, and paid API calls are expected for this data service, and the skill instructs the agent to estimate cost and obtain user consent before paid calls.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed through OpenClaw metadata and instructions for npm, npx fallback, and Node installation; versions are mostly unpinned or latest, which is a supply-chain caution but not hidden or purpose-mismatched.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording includes broad examples such as similar needs and an informal replay request, but the body narrows use to fetch_live_history and tells the agent to ask when required inputs are missing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill may install qhkit globally and unpack Node into the user's home directory, with checksum verification and no root requirement; this is disclosed setup persistence rather than a hidden background service or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes one purpose: using qhkit's fetch_live_history tool to retrieve a specified 视频号 account's live replay list for frequency or material analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable installing the @iqinghu/qhkit npm tool, providing a Qinghu API token, and spending Qinghu credits for live replay queries. Prefer a pinned qhkit version or a disposable environment if supply-chain stability matters.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger examples could cause over-invocation, but the operational instructions constrain the skill to 视频号 live replay lookup and require missing identifiers to be clarified.
[RP1] expected: The unpinned npx fallback is a real supply-chain caution, but it is a fallback install path for the declared qhkit dependency rather than an unrelated or hidden remote payload.
[RA2] expected: The Node bootstrap writes a user-local runtime and adjusts PATH, but it is disclosed, checksum-verified, dependency-related, and not configured as a background process or cross-session hook by default.
[A.I.G SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no results, which is consistent with the single Markdown artifact and absence of embedded executable code.
